title: 1. The AI Paradigm Shift
subtitle: From Tools to Co-Pilots
intro: This stage marks the critical transition where AI stops being just a background utility and becomes a primary, active co-pilot, enabling true Generative UI (GUIs) from simple prompts.
points: From Tools to Co-Pilots: AI shifting from optimization and cropping to becoming an active, creative partner in the design process.
Generative UI (GUIs): Using text prompts or data inputs to generate entire, functional user interfaces and components in seconds.
Design Systems Automation: AI ensures instant compliance with established design systems, maintaining strict brand consistency across all platforms.

title: 2. Adaptive Personalization
subtitle: Hyper-Optimization & 1:1 UX
intro: The focus moves from static design to fluid, real-time interfaces. AI dynamically constructs the user experience based on individual, real-time intent and cognitive load.
points: True 1:1 Personalization: AI dynamically adjusts layout, content density, and CTAs in real-time based on individual user intent.
Predictive A/B Testing (MVT): AI runs thousands of multivariate tests simultaneously, learning and deploying the optimal version immediately.
Accessibility-by-Default: AI automatically detects and corrects WCAG compliance issues (contrast, alt text) during the design phase.

title: 3. Code Generation & Workflow
subtitle: Pixel-to-Code Innovation
intro: Bridging the gap between design and engineering. AI translates visual concepts directly into clean, production-ready code, accelerating the development lifecycle.
points: Pixel-to-Code: Allowing designers to upload mockups (Figma, Sketch) and instantly receive production-ready code (React, Vue, HTML/CSS).
Semantic Code Generation: AI generates code that is clean, well-documented, and semantically correct, actively reducing technical debt.
Low-Code/No-Code Empowerment: AI lowers the barrier, allowing non-developers to create complex web applications, freeing designers for strategy.

title: 4. Ethical & Creative Balance
subtitle: The Human Element in AI
intro: As AI takes on more creative weight, the human role shifts toward governance, auditing, and high-level strategy, focusing on critical ethical imperatives.
points: The AI-Designer Skillset: The new role is centered on Prompt Engineering and the critical evaluation of AI outputs.
Bias Mitigation: The ethical imperative to audit AI models for inherent bias (in layout, color palettes) to ensure inclusive design outcomes.
Creative Ownership & IP: Navigating the legal and creative questions surrounding designs generated by proprietary models and protecting human work.

title: 5. The Autonomous Website
subtitle: Self-Optimizing Architecture
intro: The near future where the entire website becomes a living, self-optimizing entity that manages and updates itself based purely on real-time business metrics and user goals.
points: Self-Optimizing Architecture: Dynamic websites that autonomously restructure and update content based on user goal achievement.
AI-Powered SEO & Content Strategy: Automated creation of high-ranking content and structural changes driven purely by search intent analysis.
The 'Design as a Service' Model: AI tools evolving from static interface generation to continuous, dynamic design orchestration for a subscription.
